posts.body:
The angelcare nappy bin is currently Half Price (£7.49) at Argos.

http://www.argos.co.uk/static/Product/partNumber/3761913.htm

However, on the Angelcare website, there is a voucher to get £7.50 off, which makes the bin free!

I just picked mine up 

Here's the voucher

http://angelcareuk.co.uk/sites/default/files/Argos%20Voucher%202013.pdf

I had to talk the assistant around, as the top of the voucher says get it half price, but the bit in the T&Cs clearly says save £7.50, and the code works on the tills.

:T
